edits.old: Then the system answers with status 404
edits.new:
Then the system answers with status 404

  Scenario: AC14 A replayed write with the same idempotency key changes nothing
    Given "U-9212" has approved "A-0201" once with an idempotency key
    When "U-9212" sends the same approve call again with the same idempotency key
    Then the system returns the stored result of the first call
    Then notice "N-0201" is not approved a second time and the decision log holds one entry

  Scenario: AC15 A retried or timed-out activity records one decision
    Given an activity of the approval of "A-0201" times out after its 2 s budget
    When the activity is retried
    Then the decision log holds one entry for "A-0201" and the timed-out call is answered as missing
    Then the timed-out call never approves notice "N-0201"

  Scenario: AC16 A consumed call that fails or does not answer approves nothing
    Given the rwb-comms contract mock fails or does not answer the approve operation for notice "N-0201"
    When "U-9212" approves "A-0201"
    Then the call is answered as missing past its 2 s budget and the system refuses the approve call
    Then notice "N-0201" stays in state "Generated" and the approval status is unchanged
